description: This file defines the MetadataHeader interface, which models a key-value pair for metadata headers, including methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, comparison, and associated JSON field definitions.

classes.name: MetadataHeader
classes.description: Interface representing a metadata header with key-value pair, supporting JSON serialization, comparison, and factory methods.

classes.name: MetadataHeader.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static definitions of JSON fields for MetadataHeader serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MetadataHeader instance from a key and value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a MetadataHeader instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the header.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the header.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this header with another for ordering.
